changes: Read-only native spatial workbench in RE / DISASM: source-scoped map/category grids, source-byte inspection and selected evidence export.
Mega Man 2: 616 stage-context views across 352 physical screen slots, retaining native stage-dependent collision semantics and offscreen rows.
Ninja Gaiden: 48 room layouts with ground kinds/contact flags, plus 13 native player scripts, durations, poses, OAM pieces and grayscale CHR preview.
Zelda II: four overworld terrain maps; Castlevania II: 79 layouts and raw tile categories before conditional block substitution. Unsupported domains are explicitly labeled.
Prior audio functionality, canonical project schema, CPU/APU, native drivers, compiler and runtime emitters preserved. Original tutorials, guides and examples retained.

preservedParent.method: Exact parent source/test reconstruction and 276 protected parent files; all earlier preservation boundaries retained. Explicit test adjustments add the fourth registry profile and new candidate identity; no retained cases removed.

retainedExamples.scope: All 58 retained examples regenerated in a disposable copy. 52 files are byte-identical to the parent; six build receipts change only htmlSha256. Those six exact reproduced receipts are copied into the candidate before the final immutable gate.

audioToolImport.originalPreservation: Separate downloadable receipt includes original UTF-8 text and SHA-256; schema-12 project contains converted score only.
audioToolImport.scope: Bounded score/instrument conversion; no binary .fms project import, FamiTracker text importer, original-engine equivalence or arbitrary effect support.

audioRecognition.scope: Uncalibrated read-only routine comparisons, with physical-byte evidence and work limits. Similarity cannot authorize decoding or import; no broad accuracy or time-saving claim.

ownerAcceptance: Physical Windows/mobile, NES hardware, complete scene/behavior recovery, conditional collision and generalized engine recognition remain open.
promotion: Development review checkpoint on its own branch. Standalone app and preserved documentation included; commercial ROMs and sample payloads excluded.
roadmap: Connect validated native geometry/art to guarded canonical scene import; implement or reject unsupported behavior explicitly. Expand actor/transition and native animation decoders.

audioDriverSurvey.scope: Bounded executed base-APU writer observations; no automatic whole-library detection, engine identification or editable score conversion.
audioDriverSurvey.ownership: Existing RERuntime and RERuntimeUI; project schema 12 and canonical Audio remain unchanged.

nativeAudioLibrary.comparison: Exact APU address/value/source/cycle sequence and Float32 PCM against the committed unchanged parent CPU/APU in the same controlled initial state. Not natural-game or hardware equivalence.
nativeAudioLibrary.conversion: Finite frame-end APU-state adaptation; nearest canonical pitches, volume rows and simple duty instruments. DPCM, short-mode noise, sub-frame articulation, phase and original instrument/control-flow reconstruction remain outside editable conversion.

retainedParentSupplement.scope: Historical exact parent parity and bounded entry sweep. Three-ROM browser workflow separately rerun against the current candidate.

audioDiscovery.referenceExecution: Four controlled 64-update native windows, not natural gameplay.
audioDiscovery.comparisonMeaning: Uncalibrated four-instruction context overlap. No score authorizes decoding, conversion or an engine-family decision.
audioDiscovery.unknowns: Full song/SFX library, queue semantics, table boundaries, pointer formats, instruments, original loops and expansion audio remain unresolved unless a separate validated decoder supports them.
audioDiscovery.validationScope: Unchanged discovery implementation and derived references from three earlier titles; current 10-check browser workflow rerun. A separate exact-revision catalog now supports Mega Man 2. Discovery scores still do not authorize decoding.

parentGateCorrections.registryInventory: Two retained UI cardinality assertions now require eight installed profiles instead of five; the five original IDs are explicitly preserved and all three new profiles must remain unknown for the unrelated fixture. Case counts and all unrelated assertions are retained. The native profiles use the registry’s required probe/handler context signatures, verified against all three known ROMs and an unrelated source.
parentGateCorrections.reason: Automatic catalog discovery used the same pending WebCrypto path as Runtime Investigation and interfered with its cancellation fixture. Discovery now uses the existing independent SHA-256 helper. All 24 retained runtime cases and a new isolation regression pass unchanged.

spatialRE.scope: Decoded native geometry/categories with explicitly bounded per-title semantics; read-only evidence, not playable conversion.

retainedNativeAudioOracles.currentEvidence: Exact production native-audio/CPU/APU byte preservation, complete current gate and 34 current audio browser checks. Historical PCM/catalog oracles remain labeled with their original identity.
